text: Rewrote the Appearance row in code/packages/ui/src/Header.tsx from a label-beside-control flex row into a stacked block: label above, a full-width three-column grid for the `.seg` radiogroup, and centred buttons. Typecheck passed (exit 0) and the @yolo-twice/ui build succeeded. A Playwright script opened the Settings popover at 1440×900 and measured it: the popover's right edge is at 1286px and the segmented control's right edge at 1269px, so the control fits inside the popover with about 17px to spare.
